start: Staff & sign-in, a front desk person is on the list

steps.action: On their row tap 'Make sign-in code'
user_sees: 'Making…' on that button; every other 'Make sign-in code' button is greyed
Sheet 'Sign-in code for <name>' with a large 6-digit code
'Works once, till 5:40 pm (30 minutes).'
'<name> opens app.mettleup.fit, taps Sign in, and types +91 … and this code. Read it out, or send it on WhatsApp.'
must_not: Two codes made by two taps
A code for a different person

user_sees: WhatsApp opens on that person's number with: 'Hi <first name>!', 'Your MettleUp sign-in code for <gym>: <code>', the steps, and the panel's address on its own line
must_not: The message sent by itself
A wrong number
A gym name of another gym

steps.action: Back in the panel tap 'Copy the code'
user_sees: The button reads 'Code copied'
must_not: 'Code copied' when copying was refused

steps.action: Tap 'Done' and look at the row
user_sees: '· Code works till 5:40 pm' on the row
must_not: The code itself kept on screen or shown again later

start: The owner needs a code to sign in on a new phone

steps.action: On the own row (pill 'You') tap 'Make sign-in code'
user_sees: Sheet 'Your sign-in code'
'On the phone or computer where you want to sign in, open app.mettleup.fit, tap Sign in, and type +91 … and this code.'
'Copy the code' only
must_not: A 'Send on WhatsApp' button to the own number

steps.action: Type the number and the code on the new phone
user_sees: The gym opens there; the first device stays signed in
must_not: The first device signed out

start: The code is read out at the desk instead of sent

steps.action: Make the code and read the six digits aloud; the person types them on their phone
user_sees: The person is signed in
After the owner reopens the page the row no longer says 'Code works till'
must_not: The code working a second time

steps.action: Make a code for a person another owner removed a minute ago
user_sees: Above the list: 'That person was already removed. We updated the list.'; the row is gone
must_not: A code for a removed person

user_sees: 'Too many tries right now. Wait a little, then try again.'
must_not: No limit at all

steps.action: Make a code with the internet off
user_sees: 'Can’t reach the internet. Check the connection and try again.'; the buttons work again
must_not: All buttons stuck greyed
An empty code sheet

steps.action: As a front desk person look for the button
user_sees: 'Only an owner can add people or make sign-in codes. Ask your gym owner.'
must_not: Any way for staff to make a code

start: A code goes through its states

steps.action: Make a code, tap 'Done', then want to see it again
user_sees: No way to show it; a new one must be made
must_not: The old code shown again from memory

steps.action: Make a second code for the same person
user_sees: A new code and a new time on the row
must_not: Both codes working with nothing said about the first

steps.action: The person types the first code
user_sees: The wrong-code words with the tries left
must_not: The first code still opening the gym

steps.action: Nobody uses the second code for 31 minutes; the person tries it
user_sees: 'That PIN or code is wrong, or the code has expired. Ask the gym owner for a new code…'
must_not: A code working after its time

start: What a code lets its holder do

steps.action: Make a code for a front desk person but type it yourself on a spare phone
user_sees: Signed in as that person
must_not: Nothing on that person’s own devices or in the list that says a new device signed in as them

steps.action: Within 15 minutes set a new PIN there
user_sees: The PIN is set without the old one
must_not: The real person not told their PIN changed

steps.action: Take a fee on that phone
user_sees: The receipt names the front desk person
must_not: A receipt that names a person who was not there, with no trace of who made the code
